metadata.headline: Can a home service be booked like a product?

platform_lesson.title: Handy turns local home services into bookable appointments
platform_lesson.text: Finding a cleaner or handyman usually means contacting people, checking availability and asking for a price. Handy standardizes many common jobs so the customer can choose a service and time, see an upfront price and pay through the platform. Handy then matches the booking with an independent pro who can accept and perform the job. This makes a local service feel more like booking a hotel room than hiring a tradesperson from scratch. That only works if trust is built into the process, so Handy screens individual pros, verifies identity and backs eligible direct bookings with its Happiness Guarantee. Not every home project fits this model: larger improvement jobs can still use a referral-and-quote flow through the wider Angi network.

sources.title: Handy homepage
sources.note: Current direct-booking model: customers can instantly book cleaning and handyman tasks at an upfront price; Handy highlights Handy-Approved Pros, its Happiness Guarantee, partner access and pro jobs with no lead fees.

sources.title: Handy Terms of Use
sources.note: Explains that Handy is a communications and booking platform, customers generally pay direct-booked services in advance, prices can vary by location and recurrence, and larger home-improvement requests may use a separate referral flow.

sources.title: Trust and Safety
sources.note: Handy says millions of bookings have been completed across the US, UK and Canada, the average professional is rated 4.5/5, and individual professionals undergo credential verification and background checks using third-party providers including Jumio and Checkr.

sources.title: Handy About Us
sources.note: Describes Handy as a platform connecting people who need household services with pre-screened independent service professionals and emphasizes a fast booking process, secure payment and matching.

sources.title: All Home Services
sources.note: Shows the current breadth of standardized service categories, including cleaning, furniture assembly, TV mounting, handyman work, plumbing, electrical, painting, moving and smart-home installation.

sources.title: Apply to be a Pro — Angi Services / Handy
sources.note: Current pro proposition: independent pros can claim local jobs, choose their own schedule and see upfront pricing before claiming work; applicants need paid experience, identification, required licensing and a background check.

sources.title: The Handy Happiness Guarantee
sources.note: Explains the service guarantee for eligible jobs booked and paid for directly through Handy, including re-service for quality issues and protection for certain damage claims.

sources.title: Angi 2026 Q2 filing
sources.note: Confirms that Handy remains one of Angi’s operating brands. Angi reported about 106,000 average monthly active Pros in the US in Q2 2026 and about 15 million projects across its businesses in the twelve months ended June 30, 2026; these are Angi-network figures, not Handy-only counts.

core_value_unit.explanation: The core value unit is a booked household service with a defined task, time and price, such as cleaning, furniture assembly or TV mounting.

metrics.note: Handy says professionals have completed millions of bookings across the US, UK and Canada; this is a cumulative platform statement, not a current annual volume.

actor.explanation: Handy is an Angi brand that organizes direct service booking, matching, payment, trust tools and support while independent pros perform the work.

metrics.note: Handy says it operates in hundreds of cities across the US, Canada and the UK.

job.explanation: Handy has to turn a household need into a bookable job and connect it with a suitable local pro.

gain.explanation: Reliable completed jobs can create repeat bookings, recurring cleaning relationships and platform fees.

pain.explanation: Handy must maintain enough available pros while reducing no-shows, poor service, safety concerns and customer dissatisfaction.

transaction.explanation: Handy coordinates bookings, customer payments, pro payouts and platform trust/support fees for direct-booked services.

governance.explanation: Platform rules, cancellation policies, ratings, screening requirements and service guarantees govern participation.

promotion_channel.explanation: Handy reaches customers through search, its app and website, and partner channels that can attach services to products or properties.

activities.explanation: Handy structures services, prices bookings, matches pros, manages payments, supports appointments and handles customer issues.

resources.explanation: Core resources include the pro network, booking software, pricing logic, ratings, service definitions, payments and customer data.

actor.explanation: Customers are households, renters, landlords or businesses that need cleaning, assembly, repairs, installation or other local help.

job.explanation: Customers want to get a suitable local service completed without searching, calling and negotiating with many individual providers.

gain.explanation: For many common tasks, the customer can select a time and see an upfront price before the job is booked.

pain.explanation: Letting a stranger into a home creates trust concerns, and delays, cancellations or poor-quality work can disrupt the booking.

transaction.explanation: Customers choose a service and time and pay for eligible direct-booked services through the Handy platform.

filter.explanation: Customers select the type of job, timing and location; service availability and price depend on the market.

access_channel.explanation: Customers use Handy’s website or app to browse services, book jobs, message a pro, manage appointments and rate work.

activities.explanation: Customers describe the job, choose timing, prepare access, communicate with the pro and review the result.

resources.explanation: Customers bring the physical place and problem to be solved, job details, schedule and payment method.

actor.explanation: Independent cleaners, handymen, installers and other skilled service professionals perform the household work.

metrics.note: Handy says the average professional using the platform is rated 4.5 out of 5 stars.

job.explanation: Pros want access to local paid jobs without having to find every customer and manage every payment themselves.

gain.explanation: Pros can choose when to work and claim jobs that fit their schedule, skills and geography.

pain.explanation: Travel time, cancellations, inconsistent demand, job complexity and customer ratings can reduce earnings.

transaction.explanation: Pros accept or claim suitable jobs and perform the agreed household service.

filter.explanation: Applicants need relevant paid experience, valid identification, applicable licensing and required screening.

access_channel.explanation: Pros use Handy/Angi Services tools to review local jobs, see pricing, claim work and manage appointments.

activities.explanation: Pros review job details, travel to the customer, perform the service, communicate and close the appointment.

resources.explanation: Pros bring trade skills, time, transportation, tools, licenses where required and service experience.

actor.explanation: External identity and background-check providers support the screening layer that helps Handy approve individual pros.

job.explanation: Trust providers verify identity credentials and search background records used in pro onboarding.

gain.explanation: A larger service marketplace creates recurring demand for identity verification and screening services.

pain.explanation: Background records can be incomplete or restricted, and screening cannot guarantee future behavior.

transaction.explanation: Jumio supports identity credential verification and Checkr performs background checks for individual professionals.

filter.explanation: Screening depth depends on available records, law, geography and the type of provider being onboarded.

access_channel.explanation: Digital integrations connect Handy’s onboarding flow with third-party verification and screening systems.

activities.explanation: Partners validate identity data, search available records and return screening results to support onboarding.

resources.explanation: Key resources include identity-verification technology, databases, compliance processes and screening infrastructure.

current.explanation: The customer chooses a standardized service and time and pays through Handy for eligible direct-booked services.
Handy provides the upfront booking flow, confirms the appointment and matches the request with an available pro.
Pros provide service skills, availability and the willingness to claim or accept local jobs.
Handy routes suitable jobs to pros and handles payment for direct-booked platform work.
The pro performs the household service and the customer can communicate, review and rate the completed work.
External trust providers support identity verification and background screening used in the pro approval process.
